text:
Stop coasting at the gym. It's making you weaker.

Every time you choose the comfortable weight, you train yourself to quit. That habit becomes who you are.

The fix is three rules. Call it the always harder rule:

1. Do more than last time. Always.
2. Add weight before it feels easy. Not after.
3. Leave the gym with one rep you almost didn't make.

That pressure raises your testosterone. Hardens your mind. Makes you a man you actually respect.

Comfortable workouts are a lie you tell yourself.

More weight, more man. Same weight, same man.
caption:
The mindset of men who actually build themselves at the gym: always do more than last time, no exceptions, no comfort days.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
